answers: I do not have information on the default timeout duration for a Code Engine job.  There is no retry limit for these job runs. Any job runs for these jobs are automatically restarted without limit. If the mode daemon option is not specified when creating a Code Engine job, the job runs in task mode with a maximum execution time. If mode is not specified, by default, the job runs in task mode.
